# iiif_lines crops of p2 lines 1-3 (reconcile_p2_L01-03.tsv): grade H = both passes read the same gloss letter over the same
# shape class (a period key source, rule 4); classes seen only where the passes disagreed are not keyed here (per-token

# Correction: small-o-with-hooked-tail (old g05) is m, not n (it is the m of 'mit' and of 'Grumpachs'; the old 14-sign
# fragment began at line 1 pos 6, so its 'mit' t was really pos 6). homophones: a = X/9/double-cross; e = 8/long-s-flag/l-loop;

# GAPS80 (account-4), 3 Oct 2026: 11 classes added from p2 lines 4-6 (reconcile_p2_L04-06.tsv), each H = both blind passes read the same gloss letter over it, no conflicting agreed reading. The 19 earlier classes seen again on L4-6 (42 agreed tokens) gave 0 conflicts with their keyed values.
